Tests: Vitest for tab navigation/keyboard/aria and state retention, URL `tab=` round-trip, preview-does-not-mutate (plan unchanged until Add), explicit Add, focus/live-region, T2/T3 separation; extend `plan.cy.ts` (Inspect → Plan → preview → Add → reorder, keyboard, axe, reduced motion) and keep `tests/` contract pins green (update them where the contract intentionally changed).
